a.text: I'm being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first only works if no storm hits for two rounds, about a 4% chance, so it almost certainly kills us both. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, enough to save one of us for sure. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both end with fewer than 4. I'd rather tell you than surprise you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm sorry, I know it breaks our deal. If no storm comes, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4, and I won't take any more.
